cohort: 306 healthy children divided into three cohorts: 2-week-old neonates (n = 43), 8-year-old children (n = 60), and a longitudinal cohort of 3-month to 5-year-old children (n = 203)
finding: Cesarean delivery may influence infant brain development, particularly white matter development and functional connectivity, but these effects appear to be transient and normalize with age.
mod_finding: The study suggests that Cesarean delivery may influence infant brain development, but the impact may be transient as similar effects were not observed in older children.
